LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC.title: Template Relic
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC.descri: At the start of each turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC.flavor: A sample relic used to test the template project.
At the start of each turn, add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Doubt[/red] to your hand. Whenever you draw [blue]3[/blue] [red]Doubts[/red], gain [gold]Mania[/gold] for [blue]1[/blue] turn.
Who am I? Where am I? I'm not sick!!!
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_DENGJI: At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Regeneration[/gold] based on your Ascension count, starting at [blue]8[/blue] stacks. Each additional Ascension increases [gold]Regeneration[/gold] by half of the previous increase.
Thanks to the top donator Bahuo for the rocket gift
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_BLACKHAND.de: Whenever you apply [red]Ignite[/red], apply [blue]1[/blue] additional layer.
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_BLACKHAND.fl: It seems to be a tool made from the severed hand of a Fire Cult follower. His name was Shou San, I think...
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_HUOWOZHENJIN: [blue]Status[/blue] cards you play are [gold]Exhausted[/gold], healing [blue]3[/blue] HP for each.
With mercy at heart, fire warms all beings
Prevents the next lethal damage: heal [blue]50%[/blue] of Max HP, then become [red]Broken[/red]. Can be [gold]recharged[/gold] with the Surrogate Skin card.
Xin Su's human skin, said to be able to save your life
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_XIN_ZH: At the start of each combat, add 1 [red]Shattered Void Slash[/red] to your hand.
Because I must save Da Qi!
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_XINZHU: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [red]Intangible[/red].
If the threads of the yin and yang spindles were joined together, perhaps they could form an eternal Mobius strip.
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_TONGQI: On victory: gain random [blue]10~15[/blue] Gold for each [gold]Copper Coin[/gold] you hold.
Rich Taoists smash people with money~
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_XUANYA: Warm and smooth like jade, plain and unremarkable.
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_HUO_LI: [gold]Max Energy +1[/gold]. At the start of each combat, shuffle [blue]3[/blue] [red]Burns[/red] into your draw pile.
With this fire sickle, everyone will be well done.
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_TONGJI: Whenever you gain [red]Vulnerable[/red] or [red]Weak[/red], apply the same amount to ALL enemies.
A Taoist artifact that wards off evil with its light. Through the mirror, you seem to glimpse yourself in another world.
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_DICE18: [gold]Right-click[/gold]: [gold]Consume[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] Energy to draw [blue]1~6[/blue] cards. Roll a 6 for a jackpot!
Hehe, happy holidays. This dice shall take its leave~
Seems to be a dice from Dr. Yi's desk, with "Made in Yiwu" on the bottom
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_PING_W: [gold]Right-click[/gold]: [gold]Consume[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] Energy to [gold]Foresee[/gold] [blue]4[/blue]. Free while in [red]Danyangzi Transformation[/red].
A girl's head on a blue-and-white porcelain vase, smiling at you. Kind of cute the longer you look...
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_JIAN_T:
Gain a [gold]Bounty[/gold] at the end of combat.
Normal enemies: [blue]{NormalGold}[/blue] Gold.
Elite enemies: [blue]{EliteGold}[/blue] Gold.
BOSS: [blue]{BossGold}[/blue] Gold.
The Sky Watch Bureau - an organization founded by the nations to counter heavenly calamities. Token holders earn rewards for slaying evil spirits.
LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_LIHUOWANG2_RELIC_PIAN_J: Buy [gold]class cards[/gold] from merchants at a [gold]very low[/gold] price ([blue]0[/blue] Gold). Once you spend in a shop, this relic becomes [red]Broken[/red] and no longer works on the next merchant.
As the Deception Scripture says - mixing false and true, nine lies and one truth.
